0.3.16.en: Left-aligned the Viewer grid so dashboards start at the page edge instead of being horizontally centered.
0.3.16.de: Viewer-Grid linksbuendig ausgerichtet, damit Dashboards am Seitenrand starten statt horizontal zentriert zu sein.
0.3.16.ru: Viewer grid vyrovnen vlevo, chtoby dashboardy nachinalis ot kraya stranitsy vmesto gorizontalnogo tsentra.
0.3.16.pt: Grade do Viewer alinhada a esquerda para dashboards iniciarem na borda da pagina em vez de ficarem centralizados.
0.3.16.nl: Viewer-grid links uitgelijnd zodat dashboards aan de paginarand starten in plaats van horizontaal gecentreerd.
0.3.16.fr: Grille Viewer alignee a gauche afin que les dashboards commencent au bord de la page au lieu d'etre centres.
0.3.16.it: Griglia Viewer allineata a sinistra cosi i dashboard partono dal bordo pagina invece di essere centrati.
0.3.16.es: Grid del Viewer alineado a la izquierda para que los dashboards empiecen en el borde de la pagina en vez de centrarse.

0.3.16.zh-cn: Left-aligned the Viewer grid so dashboards start at the page edge instead of being horizontally centered.

0.3.15.en: Added Viewer page tabs and kept wide desktop browsers on the desktop layout before switching to wall layout at 1920px.
0.3.15.de: Viewer-Seitentabs ergaenzt und breite Desktop-Browser bleiben bis 1920px im Desktop-Layout statt ins Wall-Layout zu wechseln.
0.3.15.ru: Dobavleny vkladki stranits Viewer, a shirokie desktop browsery ostayutsya v desktop layout do 1920px.
0.3.15.pt: Adicionadas abas de paginas no Viewer e navegadores desktop largos ficam no layout desktop ate 1920px.
0.3.15.nl: Viewer-paginatabs toegevoegd en brede desktopbrowsers blijven tot 1920px in desktop-layout.
0.3.15.fr: Onglets de pages Viewer ajoutes et les navigateurs desktop larges restent en layout desktop jusqu'a 1920px.
0.3.15.it: Aggiunte schede pagina nel Viewer e i browser desktop larghi restano nel layout desktop fino a 1920px.
0.3.15.es: Agregadas pestanas de pagina en Viewer y navegadores desktop anchos se quedan en layout desktop hasta 1920px.
0.3.15.pl: Dodano zakladki stron Viewer, a szerokie przegladarki desktop pozostaja w layout desktop do 1920px.
0.3.15.uk: Dodano vkladky storinok Viewer, a shyroki desktop browsery zalyshayutsya v desktop layout do 1920px.
0.3.15.zh-cn: Added Viewer page tabs and kept wide desktop browsers on the desktop layout before switching to wall layout at 1920px.

0.3.14.en: Made the Viewer load dashboards through adapter sendTo before the web file URL and added Viewer load diagnostics.
0.3.14.de: Viewer laedt Dashboards nun zuerst ueber Adapter-sendTo statt Web-Datei-URL und erhaelt Lade-Diagnose.
0.3.14.ru: Viewer teper zagruzhaet dashboard cherez adapter sendTo pered web file URL i poluchil diagnostiku zagruzki.
0.3.14.pt: Viewer agora carrega dashboards via adapter sendTo antes da URL de arquivo web e adiciona diagnostica de carregamento.
0.3.14.nl: Viewer laadt dashboards nu eerst via adapter sendTo voor de web-bestands-URL en heeft laaddiagnostiek.
0.3.14.fr: Viewer charge maintenant les dashboards via adapter sendTo avant l'URL fichier web et ajoute des diagnostics de chargement.
0.3.14.it: Viewer carica ora i dashboard tramite adapter sendTo prima della URL file web e aggiunge diagnostica di caricamento.
0.3.14.es: Viewer carga ahora dashboards por adapter sendTo antes de la URL de archivo web y agrega diagnostico de carga.
0.3.14.pl: Viewer laduje dashboardy najpierw przez adapter sendTo przed URL pliku web i dodaje diagnostyke ladowania.
0.3.14.uk: Viewer teper zavantazhue dashboard cherez adapter sendTo pered web file URL i maye diahnostyku zavantazhennya.
0.3.14.zh-cn: Made the Viewer load dashboards through adapter sendTo before the web file URL and added Viewer load diagnostics.

0.3.13.en: Made Editor saves use adapter sendTo first, made save verification fatal, and added recovery for newer local dashboards.
0.3.13.de: Editor-Speichern nutzt zuerst Adapter-sendTo, Save-Verifikation ist verbindlich und neuere lokale Dashboards werden wiederhergestellt.
0.3.13.ru: Sohranenie Editor snachala ispolzuet adapter sendTo, proverka save teper obyazatelna, dobavleno vosstanovlenie bolee novyh lokalnyh dashboardov.
0.3.13.pt: Salvamento do Editor usa primeiro adapter sendTo, verificacao de save agora e obrigatoria e dashboards locais mais novos sao recuperados.
0.3.13.nl: Editor opslaan gebruikt eerst adapter sendTo, save-verificatie is verplicht en nieuwere lokale dashboards worden hersteld.
0.3.13.fr: La sauvegarde Editor utilise d'abord adapter sendTo, la verification save est obligatoire et les dashboards locaux plus recents sont recuperes.
0.3.13.it: Il salvataggio Editor usa prima adapter sendTo, la verifica save e obbligatoria e i dashboard locali piu recenti vengono recuperati.
0.3.13.es: El guardado del Editor usa primero adapter sendTo, la verificacion de save es obligatoria y se recuperan dashboards locales mas nuevos.
0.3.13.pl: Zapis Editor uzywa najpierw adapter sendTo, weryfikacja save jest obowiazkowa i nowsze lokalne dashboardy sa odzyskiwane.
0.3.13.uk: Zberezhennya Editor spochatku vykorystovuye adapter sendTo, perevirka save obovyazkova, novishi lokalni dashboardy vidnovlyuyutsya.
0.3.13.zh-cn: Made Editor saves use adapter sendTo first, made save verification fatal, and added recovery for newer local dashboards.

0.3.12.de: Editor-Admin-Socket-Erzeugung korrigiert: nutzt nun @iobroker/socket-client AdminConnection statt raw emit-only Socket.
0.3.12.ru: Ispravleno sozdanie Editor admin socket: ispolzuetsya @iobroker/socket-client AdminConnection vmesto raw emit-only socket.

0.3.12.fr: Creation socket admin Editor corrigee avec @iobroker/socket-client AdminConnection au lieu d'un raw emit-only socket.

0.3.12.zh-cn: Fixed Editor admin socket creation by using @iobroker/socket-client AdminConnection instead of a raw emit-only socket.

0.3.11.nl: Trace-gebaseerde Editor-, socket-, sendTo- en adapteropslagdiagnostiek plus info.lastDebugLog toegevoegd.
0.3.11.fr: Diagnostics par trace pour Editor, socket, sendTo et stockage adapter, plus info.lastDebugLog.

0.3.11.zh-cn: Added trace-based Editor, socket, sendTo and adapter storage diagnostics plus info.lastDebugLog.

0.3.10.en: Added copyable Editor diagnostics for dashboard load/save debugging and made frontend logging safe.
0.3.10.de: Kopierbare Editor-Diagnose fuer Dashboard-Laden/Speichern ergaenzt und Frontend-Logging abgesichert.

0.3.9.en: Fixed ioBroker socket-client file API handling and added browser and adapter diagnostics for dashboard persistence.
0.3.9.de: ioBroker-socket-client-Datei-API korrigiert und Browser-/Adapter-Diagnose fuer Dashboard-Speicherung ergaenzt.

0.3.9.fr: Gestion de la file API ioBroker socket-client corrigee et diagnostics navigateur/adapter ajoutes pour la persistance dashboard.

0.3.8.en: Made dashboard load and save use ioBroker adapter file storage directly before falling back to sendTo commands.
0.3.8.de: Dashboard-Laden und -Speichern nutzt jetzt zuerst den ioBroker-Adapter-Dateispeicher und erst danach sendTo-Kommandos.

0.3.8.nl: Dashboard laden en opslaan gebruikt nu eerst ioBroker adapter file storage en daarna pas sendTo.

0.3.7.en: Fixed Editor save confirmation handling and added legacy messagebox metadata for ioBroker sendTo compatibility.
0.3.7.de: Editor-Speicherbestaetigung korrigiert und Legacy-messagebox-Metadaten fuer ioBroker-sendTo-Kompatibilitaet ergaenzt.

0.3.7.pt: Corrigida a confirmacao de salvamento do Editor e adicionados metadados legacy messagebox para compatibilidade ioBroker sendTo.

0.3.7.fr: Confirmation de sauvegarde Editor corrigee et metadonnees legacy messagebox ajoutees pour compatibilite ioBroker sendTo.
0.3.7.it: Corretta la conferma di salvataggio Editor e aggiunti metadati legacy messagebox per compatibilita ioBroker sendTo.
0.3.7.es: Corregida la confirmacion de guardado del Editor y agregados metadatos legacy messagebox para compatibilidad ioBroker sendTo.

0.3.6.en: Enabled ioBroker sendTo message support and made Editor saves target the Viewer dashboard consistently.
0.3.6.de: ioBroker-sendTo-Nachrichten aktiviert und Editor-Speichern konsistent auf das Viewer-Dashboard ausgerichtet.
0.3.6.ru: Vklyuchena podderzhka soobshcheniy ioBroker sendTo i sohranenie v redaktore soglasovano s dashboard Viewer.

0.3.6.nl: ioBroker sendTo-berichten geactiveerd en Editor-opslag consistent op het Viewer-dashboard gericht.
0.3.6.fr: Prise en charge des messages ioBroker sendTo activee et sauvegarde de l'Editor alignee sur le dashboard Viewer.
0.3.6.it: Abilitato il supporto ai messaggi ioBroker sendTo e salvataggio Editor allineato al dashboard Viewer.
0.3.6.es: Activado el soporte de mensajes ioBroker sendTo y guardado del Editor alineado con el dashboard Viewer.

0.3.6.zh-cn: Enabled ioBroker sendTo message support and made Editor saves target the Viewer dashboard consistently.

0.3.5.en: Added robust ioBroker socket transport and removed misleading production fallback dashboards.
0.3.5.de: Robusten ioBroker-Socket-Transport ergaenzt und irrefuehrende Produktions-Fallback-Dashboards entfernt.
0.3.5.ru: Dobavlen nadezhnyy ioBroker socket transport i ubrany vvodjashchie v zabluzhdenie production fallback dashboards.

0.3.5.nl: Robuuste ioBroker-sockettransport toegevoegd en misleidende productie-fallbackdashboards verwijderd.

0.3.5.it: Aggiunto trasporto socket ioBroker robusto e rimossi dashboard fallback fuorvianti in produzione.
0.3.5.es: Agregado transporte socket ioBroker robusto y eliminados dashboards fallback enganosos en produccion.
0.3.5.pl: Dodano odporny transport socket ioBroker i usunieto mylace fallbackowe dashboardy produkcyjne.

0.3.4.en: Fixed Editor saving in ioBroker admin so dashboard changes are written to adapter storage for the Viewer.
0.3.4.de: Editor-Speichern im ioBroker-Admin korrigiert, damit Dashboard-Aenderungen in den Adapter-Speicher fuer den Viewer geschrieben werden.
0.3.4.ru: Ispravleno sohranenie v redaktore ioBroker admin, chtoby izmeneniya paneli zapisivalis v hranilishche adaptera dlya Viewer.
0.3.4.pt: Corrigido o salvamento do Editor no ioBroker admin para gravar mudancas do dashboard no armazenamento do adapter para o Viewer.

0.3.4.fr: Sauvegarde de l'Editor dans ioBroker admin corrigee pour ecrire les changements du dashboard dans le stockage adapter pour le Viewer.

0.3.4.es: Corregido el guardado del Editor en ioBroker admin para escribir cambios del dashboard en el almacenamiento del adapter para el Viewer.
0.3.4.pl: Naprawiono zapis Edytora w ioBroker admin, aby zmiany dashboardu trafialy do pamieci adaptera dla Viewera.

0.3.3.en: Fixed Viewer data loading so the web adapter reads the saved adapter dashboard instead of a stale local fallback.
0.3.3.de: Viewer-Datenladen korrigiert, damit der Web-Adapter das gespeicherte Adapter-Dashboard statt eines alten lokalen Fallbacks liest.
0.3.3.ru: Ispravlena zagruzka dannyh Viewer, chtoby web-adapter chital sohranennuyu panel adaptera vmesto starogo lokalnogo fallbacka.
0.3.3.pt: Corrigido o carregamento de dados do Viewer para o web adapter ler o dashboard salvo no adapter em vez de um fallback local antigo.
0.3.3.nl: Viewer-datalading opgelost zodat de web adapter het opgeslagen adapterdashboard leest in plaats van een oude lokale fallback.

0.3.2.nl: Viewer-gridmaten afgestemd op de Editor zodat opgeslagen layouts consistent in de web adapter renderen.
